course_name: 商業英文會議與簡報(一)
outline:
本課程旨在培養學生在商務情境中以英語參與會議與進行簡報的基礎能力。課程內容涵蓋會議常用語、簡報組織、意見表達、回應與提問等實用溝通技巧，幫助學生熟悉職場常見的英語溝通情境。透過情境對話、角色扮演、小組任務與簡短商務簡報等活動，學生將提升英語口語表達、自信與互動能力，並建立在商務會議與簡報場合中進行基本溝通的能力。
This course aims to develop their basic ability to participate in business meetings and give presentations in English. The course covers useful language and communication skills for workplace contexts, including meeting expressions, presentation organization, expressing opinions, responding to others, and asking questions. Through situational dialogues, role-plays, group tasks, and short business presentations, students will build confidence and improve their spoken English for effective communication in business meeting and presentation settings.

flexible_learning.content:
Groups design an English dialogue on course themes, use AI (LLM) to draft a 4–5 page podcast script, and record + upload audio by end of class. Practices pronunciation/intonation and AI-assisted learning.

學生分組設計與課程內容主題相關的英文情境對話，運用 AI 工具 (LLM) 輔助撰寫4-5頁 A4 的 Podcast 節目講稿，並錄製完成之音檔於課堂結束前上傳指定平台。透過此任務學生實際練習英文發音與語調，並學習運用 AI 工具提升英文學習效果。
flexible_learning.outcome:
第17-18週結束後，學生將能以英文設計並演繹與課程主題相關的Podcast情境對話，運用課堂所學詞彙與句型，並透過錄音練習發音與語調。

By Week 18, students will script and perform an English podcast dialogue on a course topic, applying class vocabulary/sentence patterns and practicing pronunciation through recording.

第17週 (週四12:00前)：繳交節目規劃書。
第18週 (週四12:00前)：繳交音檔與講稿。
